title: Qualified Experts for Your Needs
excerpt: The people who make Gallagher Restoration what it is — IICRC- and ANSI-certified technicians who treat every property like their own.
author: Aaron Gallagher
imageAlt: Gallagher Restoration certified restoration technicians on a Southern California job site

body.text: Last month we introduced the passion and leadership behind Gallagher Restoration. But behind every successful restoration project is a dedicated team of professionals who bring that vision to life. Our team isn't just highly trained and experienced — they are compassionate individuals who understand that every job is more than just repairing damage. It is about restoring homes, businesses, and peace of mind during difficult times.

At Gallagher Restoration, we take pride in hiring only the best. Our technicians are IICRC- and ANSI-certified, meeting the highest industry standards for water, fire, and mold restoration. Every team member is skilled, knowledgeable, and committed to delivering top-tier service with a customer-first approach. Whether we are responding to a water emergency, mitigating fire damage, or handling mold remediation, our crew works with precision, efficiency, and care. Our five-star Google reviews reflect the trust and satisfaction our customers have in us — proof that we don't just promise great service, we deliver it.

From the moment you call us to the final stages of restoration, you can count on our team to treat your property with the respect and attention it deserves. We are more than a restoration company — we are a team of certified professionals who genuinely care about the people we serve.
